title: Olispania Brings Inclusive Design to Its Olive Jars with Sonoco’s Orbit®
summary: Olispania has selected Sonoco’s Orbit® closure for its jarred products, reducing opening torque by up to 50%. The collaboration received Gold in the Editor’s Choice category at the Packaging News Sustainability and Impact Awards 2026.
body_markdown:
Olispania has selected Sonoco’s Orbit® closure for its jarred products, reducing opening torque by up to 50%. The collaboration received Gold in the Editor’s Choice category at the Packaging News Sustainability and Impact Awards 2026.


For Olispania, the consumer experience starts before the product is tasted: it starts with opening the jar. The Spanish brand therefore looked for a closure that could make its packaging more accessible while maintaining the product protection and premium presentation its range requires.


### Making a familiar format easier to open


Traditional twist-off jars can be challenging for people with reduced hand strength or dexterity. Orbit® addresses this barrier through a two-part metal design comprising a central, vacuum-sealed panel and an independent outer ring.


The design reduces the torque required to open the jar by up to 50% compared with traditional twist-off closures, making the format easier to use for a wider range of consumers.


Research conducted by Kadence International for Sonoco found that 100% of consumers surveyed considered Orbit® easier to open. A further 90% said they would be more likely to purchase a product using Orbit® than one using a standard closure.


### Protecting the product throughout the supply chain


The outer ring provides more than an easier opening mechanism. It also acts as a protective bumper, helping shield the seal from impacts during transportation, storage and handling. This improves the closure’s resistance to damage and helps reduce the risk of seal failure and premature spoilage.


“Olispania leverages Orbit® to protect its high-quality, nutrient-dense produce. The solution brings together the brand’s Mediterranean heritage and modern inclusive design and preserves natural taste and nutritional qualities throughout the product’s shelf life,” said Philippe Cazeaux, Senior Commercial Director at Sonoco.


### Supporting Olispania’s retail ambitions


The adoption of Orbit® also supports Olispania’s expansion into leading retailers in 2026. Its distinctive two-part design creates a visible point of differentiation on shelf, while the easier-opening experience reinforces the brand’s premium positioning.


“At Olispania, our priority has always been the quality of our products and the satisfaction of the people who choose them. Orbit® helps us make our jars easier to open for more consumers while continuing to protect the product inside. We are proud that this commitment has been recognised with a Gold Editor’s Choice Award.” Javier Ruiz, CEO


By combining easier opening, product protection and shelf differentiation in one closure, Olispania demonstrates how inclusive packaging design can support both consumer needs and commercial objectives.


### Orbit® at a glance


-


Reduces opening torque by up to 50% compared with traditional twist-off closures


-


Features a two-part inclusive design, comprising a central panel and an independent outer ring, that makes jars easier to open for people of all ages and abilities.


-


The outer ring acts as a protective bumper, helping shield the seal during transportation, storage and handling.


-


Is made from metal - a permanent material that can be recycled again and again without losing its inherent properties


-


Provides a modern, distinctive appearance that enhances shelf presence


### Make easier opening, inclusive design, and sustainability part of your packaging strategy.


With consumer demand for convenience growing and the EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR) introducing recyclability requirements from 2030, packaging strategies increasingly need to consider usability and circularity together.
